verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents that it ingests events from Sentry's open-source SDKs and aims for full Sentry API compatibility ("anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip"). Its own docs also mention inspecting event data, which implies SDK-attached context can reach the event view. However, the evidence never explicitly says breadcrumbs, tags, or user context are captured and displayed, so the story rests on inferred SDK compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of breadcrumbs, custom tags, and user context on events; any shown UI display of that context; hands-on or independent corroboration.
